briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month with compute spend accelerating. Prompt injection persists as top production risk while regulatory scrutiny intensifies in US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and DeepSeek R2 followed within days. Meta open-sourced Llama-4-405B while xAI deployed Grok-4 on custom Memphis cluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidance mandates red-teaming for all high-risk deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia Blackwell ramp reached 1.2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announced 50GW new data center capacity through 2027. TSMC 2nm yields improved to 65% for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory before the first 10T parameter model ships?
